name: British Museum
description: national museum in London, United Kingdom
llm_description: The British Museum, located in the heart of London, is a world-renowned institution housing a vast collection of art and artifacts from around the globe. Founded in 1753, it offers a fascinating journey through human history, culture, and creativity, with highlights including the Rosetta Stone and the Parthenon sculptures.

name: Tower of London
description: castle in central London, United Kingdom
llm_description: The Tower of London, a historic castle and UNESCO World Heritage Site, offers a fascinating glimpse into England's past. Home to the Crown Jewels, it features stunning architecture, immersive exhibitions, and breathtaking views of the Thames. A must-visit for history enthusiasts and families alike.

name: Royal Observatory
llm_description: The Royal Observatory in Greenwich, London, is a historic site offering fascinating insights into astronomy and timekeeping. Home to the Prime Meridian Line, it features exhibitions on celestial navigation, the history of time, and the famous 28-inch telescope. The grounds provide scenic views of the Thames and the city skyline, making it a must-visit for science enthusiasts and history buffs alike.
